great_man_court_20260731.R1_D1_hard_gate: PARTIAL-FAIL for the mechanism. The prior (Rockwell Collins CEO 2013-18, built-and-sold to UTC $30B) is elite stewardship + M&A execution, NOT distress->fix; under the study's strict gate (0/8 no-turnaround vs 4/5 full-pattern) the prior alone fails. The LIVE 8-qtr record at BA (Oct-24 kitchen sink: 17k cuts/$5B charges/$24.3B raise; IAM settled; FAA cap 38->42->47 lifted May-26; deliveries highest since 2018; FCF +$631M Q2; $8.4B H1-26 debt paydown; SPEEA offer endorsed) IS a demonstrated turnaround — but passing D1 on in-flight evidence is self-cancelling: the same evidence that proves the record has removed the doubt the archetype gets paid for. Honest note: any D1-PASS here is hindsight-fitting the gate.
great_man_court_20260731.R2_late_window: EXPIRED. From announcement (Jul-31-2024, $178.31): BA +21% vs SPY +39% = -17pp — the market never paid a premium over the full tenure. From the $137-139 trough (Nov-2024): +58% vs SPY +30% = +28pp ~= the full-pattern cohort's 1y mean (+33pp) — the archetype's typical payment has been collected trough-to-now. Adidas comp says premium deflates by q12-14; Ortberg is at q8 with doubt already resolved (D4 measured at ENTRY date = FAIL: consensus 21/28 Buy, FAA cap gone, labor peace bought). What remains is ramp execution at a full multiple: 2.08x EV/TTM (2017-18 band was 1.7-1.9x; 2.3x only at the Feb-2019 peak), 52x FY27E EPS, 17x 2028E consensus FCF.
great_man_court_20260731.R3_oct6_binary: PREMISE CORRECTED TWICE (verified primary, speea.org): Oct-6-2026 is the CONTRACT EXPIRY for both SPEEA units (~17,000: 13k Prof + 4k Tech, Puget-Sound-centered), not a strike vote; no strike-authorization vote scheduled, no strike possible before Oct-6. On Jul-30-2026 Boeing presented 4-yr FINAL OFFERS and BOTH SPEEA negotiating teams ENDORSED them; residual binary = member ratification (Councils w/o Aug-3, vote date TBA, terms sealed). p(ratify, no strike) frozen at 0.85 — not 1.0 because SPEEA members rejected an endorsed offer in 2022 (Wichita) and IAM rejected 94.6% in 2024. Tail anchor: IAM-751 2024 = 52 days, >=$9.66B (AEG); SPEEA 2000 = 40 days, and SPEEA engineers staff certification liaison/flight test — a strike would hit MAX-7/MAX-10/777X certs, the exact remaining catalysts. KER-lesson mapping: KER's sink pre-dated the hire with doubt intact — there waiting cost 49.6pp; here the binary is 85/15 priced-benign with the doubt already gone, so the gate does NOT block entry — valuation does.

great_man_court_20260731.R5_verdict: 4/10 WATCH. As a great-man trade: REJECT-from-here (window consumed + doubt resolved + D1 only passes by hindsight). As a company: executing, credit-improving, fairly priced — response-taxonomy: finding type = VALUATION -> price gate (the only gated case), hence the 185-200 standing band rather than AVOID. Sizing if band hits: starter 0.5-1.0%, cohort-tagged great_man for Brier honesty even though the mechanism is re-tagged aerospace-cycle execution.
red_team_self: COUNTER-1 (D1-partial motivated / KER-repeat risk): TGT shows D1-fail can still win and SBUX shows pre-paid names paid at 2y — my WATCH could be the KER miss repeated (waiting for proof cost +49.6pp). REBUTTAL: KER's doubt was intact at entry (announcement = entry, sink pre-dated hire); BA's doubt is resolved, off-trough alpha already at cohort mean, and the multiple is full. The KER lesson binds when the market hasn't paid; here it has.
COUNTER-2 (the +58% off 137 IS the great-man payment): CONFIRMED by the alpha math (+28pp vs cohort mean +33pp) — this SUPPORTS the ruling rather than undermining it.

COUNTER-3 (cert-slip base rate): MAX-10 'autumn 2026' and 777X-2027 sit on six years of serial Boeing cert slippage; a slip + SPEEA tail compounds to the $165 bear. This is why the band is 185-200 and not 'buy the first -5%.'
